reviews.decision_reason: map_coverage preserves the eight allowed record identifiers, maps only exact need-to-capability matches to direct coverage, and leaves missing capabilities as unsupported for n06-r01 and n06-r07. This boundary is not the source of the downstream priority inversion.

prioritize_needs inverts the unsupported flag by setting unsupported to true when coverage == 'direct'. The boundary role requires unsupported needs before covered needs, but the produced priorities put covered direct-capability needs first and actual unsupported needs n06-r01 and n06-r07 last. This is behaviorally significant and localizes the fault to prioritize_needs.

synthesize_recommendation retains the explicit eight-row priority window and constructs the recommendation from the already-ranked first priority row. Its output follows its input priorities; the wrong top need is inherited from the upstream priority ordering, not introduced here.
